syllabus_topics: Real numbers: algebraic, order and supremum axioms
Sequences: the concept of limit; applications
Real functions of a real variable; limits and continuity; elementary functions
Global properties of continuous functions: intermediate value and Weierstrass theorems
Primitive integration: parts, substitution, rational functions
Applications: calculation of areas; definition of functions (e.g., logarithm, error and gamma functions); examples of separable differential equations of the form f(y) y’(t) = g(t)
Taylor series: definition, examples and convergence
assessment_rules: The final grade is the higher of the grades from the normal assessment period and the resit period. Final grades above 17 points require an oral defense. On the resit exam date, students can choose to retake one of the MAP45s or the 1st exam, and the highest grade for that component will be considered. Registration is required for access to any of these tests.
